evidence: Clicking "API" module filter reduced the 19-document list to exactly the 5 API-module documents (API Versioning Strategy, Error Handling Standards, HTTP Methods Guide, Rate Limiting, REST API Design Guidelines), each tagged "API".

Selecting "REST API Design Guidelines" displayed title (REST API Design Guidelines), description, module API, date 2024-01-15, version v2.3.0, three Content Sections (REST Principles, Endpoint Naming Conventions, Pagination & Filtering), and a Related Documents list with 4 entries.

Clicking the "HTTP Methods Guide" reference link inside an expanded content section navigated the document view to the "HTTP Methods Guide" document (heading, description, date 2024-01-08, v1.1.0 all updated).

Clicking "HTTP Methods Guide" link in the collapsed "Endpoint Naming Conventions" section kept the document as "REST API Design Guidelines" and showed toast "Please expand the section to access links". After expanding the section, clicking the same link navigated to the "HTTP Methods Guide" document.
Collapsing "Method Semantics" section hid its body paragraph and made "REST API Guidelines" link non-clickable (cursor removed), while the section header remained available to reopen.
Re-expanding "Method Semantics" restored the body paragraph text and made the "REST API Guidelines" reference link clickable again (cursor=pointer).

Each section header shows a chevron icon that toggles; expanded sections show body+active links, collapsed sections hide body and disable links, matching the toggle icon direction observed for REST Principles (expanded), Endpoint Naming Conventions/Idempotency Requirements (collapsed).
Programmatic parse of the source data (src/data/documents.ts) for all 19 documents found zero cases where a document's own id appears in its own relatedDocs list or its own section links (docId).

Clicking "API Versioning Strategy" node added a larger highlight circle (r=28) with thicker stroke (width 3 vs 2) behind the node, a clear selection indicator. Zoom In changed indicator from 100% to 120%; Zoom Out/Reset also available.

Graph rendered 19 node labels (matching all 19 documents) and 19 connection lines (matching the 19 unique relatedDocs relationships parsed from source data). Zoom In/Out and Reset View controls are present to bring the full graph into view.

SVG graph contains one node (circle pair) per document (19 total) each colored/grouped by module (Modules legend: API, Authentication, Data Layer, UI Components, Core System), and 19 <line> edges matching the 19 unique related-document relationships in the data.

issue: Graph node click does not open document view
actual: Clicking a knowledge-graph node (verified via real click and via synthetic pointerdown/pointerup/click/dblclick dispatched directly on the node's circle element) only toggles a visual selection ring (circle radius grows from 20 to 28, stroke-width 2→3). The main content area remains the Knowledge Graph view; no document title/description appears, no tab switch occurs, and no "view document" control appears after selection. Tried single-click, click sequences with detail 1/2, and native dblclick — none navigated to the document view.

issue: Graph node click sets selected document but does not switch to document view
actual: Clicking the "Rate Limiting" graph node updates the app's selected-document state (confirmed: manually switching to the Documents tab afterward shows "Rate Limiting" as the open document) but the active tab remains "Knowledge Graph" (nav class stays highlighted on Knowledge Graph) and the document content is not rendered anywhere on the Knowledge Graph screen. The user must manually click the "Documents" tab to see the opened document, which is exactly the separate tab change the requirement says should not be required.

evidence: Nav bar exposes three buttons: "Documents", "Knowledge Graph", "Favorites". Clicking each switches the main content area to the corresponding view (document list/detail, force-directed graph, favorites list) and highlights the active tab.

After selecting "Rate Limiting" document and collapsing its "Rate Limit Tiers" section, then zooming the graph to 120%, switching Documents→Knowledge Graph→Favorites→Documents preserved: the selected document (Rate Limiting stayed open throughout, verified in Favorites and Documents views), the collapsed state of "Rate Limit Tiers" (body text absent in all views), and the graph zoom level (120% retained when revisiting Knowledge Graph tab).

Added 3 favorites (JWT Authentication, HTTP Methods Guide, Rate Limiting) via star buttons. Nav badge updated instantly to "Favorites 3". Favorites tab listed all 3 correctly. Markers survived sort-by-Module and module filter (AUTH) changes. Favorites tab content is independent of Documents tab module filter (showed all 3 while AUTH filter was active in Documents view). After full page reload (browser_navigate to same URL), badge still read "Favorites 3" and all three documents (JWT Authentication, HTTP Methods Guide, Rate Limiting) still showed "Remove from favorites" state, confirming favorites persist across reload via localStorage.

Searching "zzznonexistentquery123" (no matches) displayed clear message "No documents found" / "Try adjusting your search or filter criteria" in place of the document list. Combined criteria test (search "JWT" + module filter "DATA", which have no overlap) also correctly showed the same no-results message. Clearing the search text alone restored the full document list; clearing both search text and module filter (setting back to "All") restored all 19 documents (verified via DOM query returning exactly 19 h3 titles matching the full known document set).
